# netbox_circuit_provider_networks (Data Source)

Retrieves all circuit provider networks from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get All Provider Networks
data "netbox_circuit_provider_networks" "all" {
}

// Get Provider Network by Name
data "netbox_circuilt_provider_networks" "name" {
    name = "provider_network"
}

// Get Provider Network by Regex
data "netbox_circuit_provider_networks" "nameregex" {
    name_regex = "provider_.*"
}

// Get Provider Network by Tag
data "netbox_circuit_provider_networks" "tag" {
    filter {
        name    = "tag"
        value   = "service-a"
    }
}

// Get Provider Network by Tags
data "netbox_circuit_provider_networks" "tags" {
    filter {
        name    = "tag"
        value   = "service-a"
    }
    filter {
        name    = "tag"
        value   = "service-b"
    }
}

// Get Provider Networks with Limit
data "netbox_circuit_provider_networks" "limit" {
    limit   = 10
    filter {
        name    = "tag"
        value   = "service-a"
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.
- `name_regex` (String) The name regex of the circuit provider networks.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `provider_networks` (Attributes List) The Provider Networks found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provider_networks))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--provider_networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provider_networks`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the circuit provider networks.
- `created` (String) When the Provider Networks was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the circuit provider networks, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the circuit provider networks.
- `last_updated` (String) When the Provider Networks was last changed.
- `name` (String) The name of the circuit provider networks.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the Provider Networks.
- `provider_id` (Number) The ID of the provider associated with the circuit provider networks.
- `provider_network_id` (Number) The ID of the provider network associated with the circuit provider networks.
- `service_id` (String) The ID of the service associated with the circuit provider networks.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
